targets.title: Cryogenic oxygen density
targets.caption: Oxygen density at 5.61 MPa compares PR, volume-translated PR, and NIST values.

plot_views.design: Two model lines; NIST hollow circles. Our sampled values use sparse filled markers; one color per model, provenance by dash/marker.
Separate relative-error subplot versus NIST, with 85 K inset.

targets.note: At 85 K the paper gives NIST density1177.2 kg/m^3; reported errors10.33% PR and0.005% PR-VTA. The reference NIST version is not pinned. Raw samples remain visible. Plot interpolation uses shape-preserving PCHIP within each continuous branch only. No extrapolation. Numerical metrics use raw values, not display curves.

targets.title: Flamelet strain response and extinction
targets.caption: Maximum flamelet temperature falls with scalar dissipation; full and reduced mechanisms extinguish at different rates.

plot_views.design: Logarithmic chi axis. Two mechanism lines with visible raw solved points; separate tool views.
Extinction bracket per mechanism; mark last-burning and first-extinguished solve. Never interpolate across extinction.

targets.title: G2 mean OH* emission and reconstructed flame
targets.caption: Panel C averages200 OH* exposures. Panel D combines the Abel inversion with mean dense-jet backlighting for G2.

plot_views.design: Keep C line-of-sight mean emission distinct from D Abel-inverted mean slice+backlighting. Compare each only with its corresponding forward optical operator.
Equal-aspect x/dO2,y/dO2 images with identical field extent; relative scales stated separately.
Axial emission integral, radial cuts, and flame-envelope curves in separate panels; baseline/raw digitization points remain visible.

targets.note: Original image has no calibrated numerical colorbar or coordinate axes. Establish image-scale transform with uncertainty before scoring length. D combines two observables. G2 flame~11dO2 and core~7dO2 are textual estimates. No absolute OH* concentration. Original and CandelFig10b are the same experiment.

targets.title: G2 near-injector CH* flame attachment
targets.caption: The G2 nearfield combines an Abel-inverted CH* emission slice and mean dense-oxygen jet backlighting.

plot_views.design: Injector lip-aligned nearfield with equal aspect; CH* and optical backlight overlay identified separately.
Flame-edge standoff and envelope with pixel-derived uncertainty; no arbitrary geometry regression.

targets.note: CH* is not CH or OH. Need an appropriate excited-state diagnostic before numerical validation. Uncalibrated raster and no physical axes limit quantitative claims.

targets.title: G2 LES synthetic OH* comparison
targets.caption: Mean synthetic OH* is compared with Singla G2 OH* emission; it shifts the bright region downstream relative to ground-state OH.

plot_views.design: Full reference and computed images adjacent on identical axes, not opposing half-images. Separate experiment and simulation labels.
Axial/radial relative-emission profiles and envelope; one comparison per panel.
Flame length, peak location, and mean-field changes over independent averaging windows.

targets.note: Compute the nonlinear OH* proxy each time step, then average. Proxy(mean fields) is different. Authors do not reproduce rear blooming and abrupt end fully. Their result is not ground truth.

targets.title: Ground-state OH diagnostic beside OH*
targets.caption: Mean simulated ground-state OH is visually compared with measured OH* radiation in the paper.

plot_views.design: Show OH and OH* from the same run separately with clear species labels; independently normalized displays explicitly tagged.

targets.note: OH and OH* are different quantities. This panel must not be a pass/fail experimental match. It demonstrates why the optical forward model matters.

targets.title: RANS EDC mechanism sensitivity
targets.caption: Centerline temperature compares EDC with modified Jones-Lindstedt and a41-reaction skeletal methane mechanism.

plot_views.design: Two mechanism curves. Separate paper+our result panel per mechanism. Grey EXP span labelled optical end-location proxy, not temperature measurement.
Difference to digitized simulation curves only; explicit sampling/geometry uncertainties.

targets.note: Geometry/inlet velocity inconsistencies must be resolved before exact reproduction. EXP grey band comes from optical flame-end position; no measured centerline temperature is given. Raw samples remain visible. Plot interpolation uses shape-preserving PCHIP within each continuous branch only. No extrapolation. Numerical metrics use raw values, not display curves.

targets.title: RANS equilibrium and flamelet sensitivity
targets.caption: Four centerline temperature profiles compare equilibrium-PDF and steady-laminar-flamelet closures with two reduced mechanisms.

plot_views.design: One panel for equilibrium and one for steady flamelet, two mechanisms each. Supplement one panel per exact case with paper+our result.
Summarize simulated peak locations and optical end-location band, with different labels.

targets.note: A source implementation comparison, not proof that FGM is invalid. FGM and steady flamelet/equilibrium PDF are different models. Source temperature values are numerical. targets.note: The paper reports an OH* intensity mismatch and does not model optical absorption/re-emission or line-of-sight effects. Compare flame shape and peak-emission positions; do not interpret the experimental colors using the LES molar-concentration range. Only the G2 image and the x/d ruler printed immediately above it are retained. C60 and A60 data panels are excluded. No colorbar is retained; G2 has no separate colorbar in the original. The paper caption specifies 1e-6 to 1e-5 mol/m3 for the G2 LES color range; the experimental lower half is an emission visualization, not a calibrated molar-concentration field. The full ruler is retained to preserve its x/d label and ticks; its extent exceeds the G2 image width.
